title: RGB LED Strip Lights 10 m with Remote, App Control and Music Sync
description:
Colour-changing LED strip for bedrooms, desks, shelves and gaming corners. Stick it along any clean, dry surface and pick colours from the remote or the phone app.
• Length 10 m (2 × 5 m rolls), 300 RGB LEDs, cuttable every 3 LEDs
• 16 million colours, scene modes and a built-in microphone for music sync
• Control by 44-key remote or free app over Bluetooth
• Self-adhesive backing; 12 V adapter with EU plug included

title: USB LED TV Backlight 2 m for 32–55 Inch Screens, RGB with Remote
description:
Adds soft ambient light behind a TV or monitor, so evening viewing feels more relaxed and the wall behind the screen glows instead of staying dark.
• 2 m strip in 4 pre-cut 50 cm pieces with corner connectors
• Powered from the TV's USB port (5 V), so it can switch on and off with the screen
• 16 colours, 4 dynamic modes and adjustable brightness via a 24-key remote
• Strong self-adhesive tape, no tools needed

title: LED Rope Light 5 m, RGB Colour Changing, USB Powered with Remote
description:
Flexible rope light that bends around corners and outlines desks, mirrors, shelves or the edge of a bed frame.
• Length 5 m, 10 mm flexible PVC tube with LEDs every 2.5 cm
• RGB with 20 colours and dynamic modes, controlled by remote
• USB powered (5 V), works with a phone charger or power bank
• Mounting clips and adhesive pads included; for indoor use

title: LED Ceiling Light 24 W, Round Flush Mount 30 cm
description:
Slim flush-mount ceiling light that replaces an old fitting in hallways, bedrooms, kitchens and bathrooms.
• 24 W LED, 2400 lumens, as bright as a 150 W incandescent bulb
• Diameter 30 cm, height 5 cm; opal acrylic diffuser for even, glare-free light
• IP44 splash-proof, suitable for bathrooms
• Hardwired to 230 V mains; installation by a qualified electrician recommended

title: Hand-Woven Rattan Pendant Light Shade 30 cm with E27 Cord Set
description:
Natural rattan shade that casts warm, patterned light over a dining table, kitchen island or reading corner.
• Dome shade approx. 30 cm wide × 32 cm high, hand-woven natural rattan
• Includes ceiling canopy, 1 m adjustable fabric cable and E27 lamp holder
• Max. bulb 40 W, LED recommended (bulb not included)
• Hardwired to 230 V mains; installation by a qualified electrician recommended

title: Industrial Metal Dome Pendant Light 30 cm, E27
description:
Matte metal pendant with a wide dome shade that directs light down onto tables, worktops and kitchen islands.
• Shade: powder-coated steel, Ø 30 cm, white inner reflector
• 1.2 m cable, height adjustable at the ceiling canopy
• E27 lamp holder, max. 60 W (bulb not included)
• Hardwired to 230 V mains; installation by a qualified electrician recommended

title: Retro Gooseneck Desk Lamp with E27 Socket and Weighted Base
description:
Flexible metal desk lamp that bends to put light exactly where you need it for reading, homework or crafts.
• Adjustable gooseneck arm and metal shade, height approx. 45 cm
• E27 socket, max. 40 W; works with LED bulbs (not included)
• Weighted round base keeps the lamp steady
• 1.5 m cable with inline switch and EU plug

title: Wooden Tripod Table Lamp with Linen Drum Shade
description:
Scandinavian-style table lamp with a natural wood tripod base and a soft linen shade for living rooms and bedside tables.
• Height 48 cm, shade Ø 25 cm
• Base: solid pine with natural finish; shade: linen-look fabric
• E27 socket, max. 40 W (bulb not included)
• 1.8 m cable with inline switch and EU plug

title: Floor Lamp 155 cm with Fabric Shade and Foot Switch
description:
Slim floor lamp that adds warm, indirect light next to a sofa, armchair or bed.
• Height 155 cm, conical fabric shade Ø 30 cm
• Gold-tone metal stem and heavy round base
• E27 socket, max. 40 W (bulb not included)
• 2 m cable with foot switch and EU plug

title: LED Floodlight 50 W, IP65 Waterproof, for Yard and Driveway
description:
Bright, compact floodlight for driveways, yards, garages and building entrances.
• 50 W LED, 5000 lumens, 120° beam angle
• IP65 aluminium housing with tempered glass front
• Adjustable mounting bracket for walls and eaves
• 1 m cable with EU plug

title: Outdoor Up and Down Wall Light, IP54 Aluminium, GU10
description:
Modern wall light that throws beams up and down for a striking look on facades, entrances and terraces.
• Die-cast aluminium with black powder coating
• IP54 weatherproof for covered and open outdoor walls
• 2 × GU10 sockets, max. 2 × 7 W LED (bulbs not included)
• Hardwired to 230 V mains; installation by a qualified electrician recommended

title: Copper Wire Fairy Lights 10 m, 100 LEDs, USB with Remote
description:
Thin, bendable copper-wire fairy lights for bedrooms, shelves, jars, wreaths and party tables.
• Length 10 m with 100 micro LEDs at 10 cm spacing
• 8 lighting modes, timer and dimming via a 13-key remote
• USB powered (5 V), so a phone charger or power bank will run it
• IP44 wire and LEDs, suitable for sheltered outdoor use

title: Outdoor Festoon String Lights 15 m with 15 Shatterproof Bulbs, EU Plug
description:
Café-style string lights for patios, pergolas, balconies and garden parties. The plastic bulbs survive knocks and drops that would break glass.
• Length 15 m with 15 E27 sockets at 1 m spacing
• 15 + 2 spare ST45 LED bulbs, 1 W each, warm white 2700 K
• IP65 weatherproof cable and sockets; connect up to 3 sets end to end
• 3 m lead cable with EU plug

title: Curtain Fairy Lights 3 × 3 m, 300 LEDs, USB with Remote
description:
Window curtain lights that turn a plain wall, window or headboard into a softly glowing backdrop.
• Size 3 × 3 m: 10 strands of 30 LEDs hanging from a 3 m top wire
• 8 lighting modes and timer via remote
• USB powered (5 V) with a 1.5 m lead cable
• Clear hooks included for easy hanging

title: 3D Moon Lamp 15 cm with 16 Colours, Touch Control and Wooden Stand
description:
A realistic moon surface printed in fine 3D layers that glows softly on a bedside table, desk or bookshelf.
• Diameter 15 cm, lightweight PLA shell
• 16 colours and 4 modes via remote; tap the base to switch between warm and cool white
• Built-in rechargeable battery for 8–12 hours, charged by USB cable (included)
• Wooden display stand included

title: Mushroom Night Light, Rechargeable with Touch Dimming
description:
Mushroom-shaped lamp with a frosted dome that gives a soft, warm glow for nurseries, bedrooms and late-night reading.
• Height 20 cm, dome Ø 15 cm
• Touch the top to switch on and dim in 3 steps
• Built-in battery lasts up to 20 hours at low brightness; USB-C charging
• LED stays cool to the touch; stable weighted base

title: Vintage LED Filament Bulbs E27 ST64, 4 Pack, Amber Warm White
description:
Edison-style bulbs with glowing filaments for bare-bulb pendants, wall lamps and string lights, using a fraction of the energy of old bulbs.
• 4 W LED (replaces 40 W), 400 lumens, 2200 K amber glow
• E27 base, ST64 shape (64 × 140 mm), clear amber glass
• Rated life 15,000 hours
• Not dimmable

title: LED Light Bulbs E27 A60 9 W, 6 Pack
description:
Everyday frosted LED bulbs that replace 60 W incandescent bulbs in ceiling lights, table lamps and floor lamps.
• 9 W, 806 lumens, replaces 60 W
• E27 screw base, A60 shape, frosted cover
• Instant full brightness and rated life of 15,000 hours
• Energy class F; not dimmable

title: Solar Garden Path Lights, 6 Pack, Warm White
description:
Push-in solar lights that line paths, driveways and flower beds with a soft glow, switching on automatically at dusk.
• Set of 6, each 38 cm tall with a ground spike
• Built-in solar panel and 600 mAh rechargeable battery
• Up to 8 hours of light after a sunny day
• IP44 weatherproof ABS and aluminium in black; no wiring needed

title: Solar Hanging Lantern with Flicker Effect, Metal Frame
description:
Traditional-look lantern that charges by day and glows at night on trees, pergolas, fences and balconies.
• Size approx. 13 × 13 × 25 cm, powder-coated metal frame with clear panels
• Warm white LED with steady or flickering candle mode
• Solar panel on the roof with automatic dusk-to-dawn switching; 6–8 hours of light
• Hanging handle and wall hook included; IP44
